contract SindraRuntime v1
runtime: KONAET_KO_ASSERT_V1
symbol: SND
decimals: 9
supplyAtomic: 1000000000000000000

rule transferPositive: transfer.amountAtomic > 0
rule transferMaximum: transfer.amountAtomic <= 1000000000000000000
rule transferBalance: transfer.amountAtomic <= state.senderBalance
rule transferNonce: transfer.nonce == state.nextNonce
rule transferNetwork: transfer.networkId == state.networkId
rule transferRoot: transfer.previousRoot == state.root
rule closureNonempty: closure.actCount > 0
rule closureCount: closure.actCount <= 64
rule closureBytes: closure.byteLength <= 262144
end
